_comment: Hand-maintained capability scores (0-1). Wins over anything scripts/update_catalog.py derives; the updater never overwrites these. quality=general reasoning, coding=code tasks, speed=normalised output tokens/sec. input_cost_per_1m / output_cost_per_1m / context are optional and only needed for models the LiteLLM price sheet does not cover (NVIDIA NIM chat models, self-hosted endpoints).
_price_note: NVIDIA build.nvidia.com runs on free dev credits, so there is no public per-token rate. The numbers above are comparable-model estimates, tagged estimated-price. They exist so cost-aware routing has a real signal instead of treating NVIDIA as free and always picking it.
